app.name: Korinnia
app.tagline: A family archive and tree for future generations

home.comingSoon: The interactive family tree will appear here soon.

auth.passwordRules: At least 10 characters. A short phrase is easy to remember and hard to guess.
auth.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator for a reset link.
auth.mfaHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

invite.title: Join the family archive
invite.toTree: You have been invited to the tree “{{tree}}” as {{role}}.
invite.asAdmin: You have been invited as an administrator.
invite.nameHint: How other family members will see you.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.changePasswordHint: You will be signed out on all other devices.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Protects your account with a code from an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password) in addition to your password. Strongly recommended for administrators.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
twoFactor.saveCodes: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe (e.g. print them). Each can be used once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
twoFactor.codeOrRecovery: Code from the app, or a recovery code.
twoFactor.passwordToDisable: Required to turn off two-step verification.

trees.title: Family trees
trees.empty: You don't have access to any family tree yet. Ask an administrator to invite you.
trees.emptyAdmin: There are no trees yet. Create the first one.
trees.name: Name
trees.confirmDelete: Delete the tree “{{name}}”? It will be hidden for everyone (data is kept and can be restored).

members.title: Members
members.addHint: Existing users are added immediately. For a new email address you get an invitation link to send yourself.
members.invited: Invitation created. Send this link to the person — it is valid for 7 days and works once.
members.confirmLeave: Remove yourself from this tree? You will lose access.

roleHelp.viewer: Can view everything in the tree, but cannot change anything.
roleHelp.contributor: Can view and suggest changes, stories and comments; an editor approves them.
roleHelp.editor: Can add and edit people, relationships, media and stories.
roleHelp.admin: Editor rights plus managing the tree's members.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.hint: Invite someone to a tree, or as an administrator of the whole installation.

users.title: Users
users.createHint: Creates an account with a password you choose. Usually an invitation link is more convenient.
users.name: User
users.resetLinkHint: Send this link to {{name}}. It works once and expires {{date}}.
users.confirmDisable2fa: Turn off two-step verification for {{name}}? Only do this if you have verified their identity.
users.confirmDelete: Permanently delete the account of {{name}}? Their contributions stay in the archive. Deactivating is usually the better choice.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.csrf_failed: Your session token expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.mfa_session_expired: The sign-in took too long. Please start again.
errors.token_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.token_invalid: Your session is invalid. Please sign in again.
errors.token_revoked: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.tree_not_found: This tree does not exist or you don't have access to it.
errors.member_not_found: This person is not a member of the tree.
errors.link_invalid: This link is invalid, has expired, or has already been used.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member of the tree.
errors.last_tree_admin: A tree must keep at least one administrator.
errors.last_superadmin: The installation must keep at least one active superadmin.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot deactivate yourself or remove your own superadmin rights.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.invitation_already_accepted: This invitation has already been accepted.
errors.sibling_needs_parents: To add a sibling, first add at least one parent.
errors.invalid_other_parent: The chosen person is not a parent of this person.
errors.vital_exists: This person already has this record (birth or death).
errors.vital_needs_one_principal: Birth and death need exactly one main person.
errors.relationship_cycle: This would make a person their own ancestor.
errors.too_many_biological_parents: A person can have at most two biological parents.
errors.self_relation: A person cannot be related to themselves.
errors.invalid_place: The place does not exist in this tree.
errors.place_in_use: The place is still used by events.
errors.not_in_trash: This item is not in the trash.
errors.entity_deleted: Restore the item from the trash first.

canvas.search: Find a person, place or year…
canvas.empty: This tree has no people yet.
canvas.emptyHint: People can be added in builder mode (coming in the next phase) or by importing a GEDCOM file later.

warnings.death_before_birth: Death date is before birth date.
warnings.living_too_old: Marked as living but would be {{years}} years old.
warnings.child_born_before_parent: A child is born before their parent.
warnings.parent_too_young: A parent would have been only {{age}} at the child's birth.
warnings.parent_too_old: A parent would have been {{age}} at the child's birth.
warnings.born_after_parent_death: A child is born after the parent's death.
warnings.event_before_birth: An event is dated before birth.
warnings.event_after_death: An event is dated after death.

builder.resetLayoutConfirm: Forget all manually moved card positions in this tree?

map.hint: Click on the map to set the location.

markdown.draftFound: An unsaved draft from {{date}} was found in this browser.
markdown.hint: Formatting: # Heading, **bold**, *italic*, - list, [link](https://…). Drafts are kept in this browser until saved.

events.title: Title
events.confirmDelete: Move this event to the trash?

family.confirmUnlink: Remove this relationship? (It can be restored from the trash.)

history.hint: Every change is kept. Restoring an older version creates a new version, so it can be undone too.
history.confirm: Restore the person to this version?

delete.title: Delete person
delete.question: Move {{name}} to the trash? Together with them:
delete.trashNote: Nothing is destroyed — everything can be restored from the trash.

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Deleted items stay here and can be restored at any time. A person is restored together with the relationships and events deleted with them.
